observation_boundary: iOS unique remote composer.controls exposes effectivePermissionMode; not the underlying local composer. Current source applies authoritative controls when present, but captured runtime controls/event sequence is unavailable.
source_findings: ConversationModel initial requested/effective permission values are auto.
Remote reconcile overwrites requested/effective when update.controls is non-nil. Nil preserves existing values.
Replay occurs before reconciliation; separate controls events have active model guard. Reconcile sets the active model before applying its controls snapshot.
Asynchronous model listing does not itself change permission values.
Shared Rust reducer stores controls from snapshot or ConversationControlsChanged events; Desktop snapshot includes controls only when its runtime has that event.
hypothesis_not_established: Initial/missing controls or event ordering could leave iOS default Auto; actual failing update sequence must be captured before assigning root cause.
required_follow_up: Reproduce on stable device, inspect authoritative controls/event ordering, fix owning path and verify a newly signed iOS app. Do not change engine permissions merely to match the label.
